mapper.select: SELECT r.role_name FROM roles r INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.role_name

SELECT u.id, u.email, u.enabled, u.locked_reason AS lockedReason, u.locked_at AS lockedAt, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_name ORDER BY r.role_name SEPARATOR ',') AS roleNames FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
AND u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{email}, '%')
AND u.enabled = #{enabled}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur2 INNER JOIN roles r2 ON r2.id = ur2.role_id WHERE ur2.user_id = u.id AND r2.role_name = #{roleName} )
GROUP BY u.id, u.email, u.enabled, u.locked_reason, u.locked_at ORDER BY u.id
